# NASAMS is combat-ready for Australian Army


September 16, 2026


- Share this article on Facebook
- Share this article on Twitter
- Share this article on LinkedIn
- Share this article via email


***System enters full service, expanding Army’s air defence coverage***


CANBERRA, Australia, (Sept. 16, 2026) – Raytheon Australia, part of RTX’s (NYSE: RTX) Raytheon business, has announced that the NASAMS™ air defence system is combat-ready for the Australian Army. This completes a multi-year project to deliver a modern air defence system to protect Australia’s service members and critical infrastructure.


With NASAMS, the Army can quickly detect, track and respond to airborne threats such as aircraft, drones and cruise missiles. The Australian configuration builds on the baseline system with adaptations for local operating environments and mission needs, incorporating Australian-designed radar technology.
“With Australian soldiers now trained to operate the system, NASAMS is fully integrated, trained and ready to deliver the protection Australia needs today,” said Ohad Katz, managing director of Raytheon Australia. “Sustained combat success has driven global demand for NASAMS, and RTX is investing to accelerate production of these critical capabilities.”
NASAMS is a highly adaptable, combat-proven short-range air defence system. The Australian variant includes CEA radars, Kongsberg’s Fire Distribution Centre, the Raytheon High Mobility Launcher on the Hawkei vehicle, a Raytheon Australia multispectral ground system, and Raytheon’s effector suite, including the AMRAAM®, AMRAAM ER and AIM 9X® missiles.


**About Raytheon Australia**


Since its establishment in 1999, Raytheon Australia has been focused on delivering capability and innovative solutions in support of the Australian Defence Force’s mission. Raytheon Australia is committed to working collaboratively with industry partners and Defence to promote national security. Raytheon Australia currently has a team of more than 1,300 people delivering high-tech capability across all domains: Maritime Systems, Defence Support Systems and Multi Domain Effects.
For more information about Raytheon Australia, visit our website here.


**About RTX**


With more than 180,000 global employees, we push the limits of technology and science to redefine how we connect and protect our world. With industry-leading capabilities, we advance aviation, engineer integrated defense systems for operational success, and develop next-generation technology solutions and manufacturing to help global customers address their most critical challenges. The company, with 2025 sales of more than $88 billion, is headquartered in Arlington, Virginia.
